notes: OPT-NC official news (2021-12-10) states UNC's PNT (Pôle Numérique de Nouvelle-Calédonie) has been operational since the 2019 academic year, with a data center/server room installed at UNC Nouville and high-performance computing servers being installed; OPT-NC sponsors a 10 Gbps leased link between UNC Nouville and IRD Ansa Vata. Academic/research computing facility, not commercial colocation. No MW capacity disclosed.
